newsitem.title: USA: Cold, wet Texas weather gives way to warmer temps.
newsitem.headline: Cold, wet Texas weather gives way to warmer temps.

text.p: Cold, wet weather gave way to warmer temperatures in Texas during the week ended Sunday, the weekly state crop report said.
"Harvest operations were slow until mid-week in the Plains, however progress resumed as fields dried," the report said. "Supplemental feeding activity continued to increase in many areas."
The report said most small grains fields in the Plains were off to a good start and have continued to show improvement over the past several weeks with plentiful moisture.
Texas wheat was rated 76 percent of normal, versus 72 percent last week and 51 percent last year.
Sorghum harvested 99 percent vs 98 w/a, 100 y/a, 100 avg.
Cotton harvested 82 percent vs 75 w/a, 84 y/a, 83 avg.
Pasture and range condition was rated 34 percent good to excellent, versus 38 percent at that level last week.
